newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNOC well continues to flow oil.
newsitem.headline: PNOC well continues to flow oil.

text.p: A well drilled off the southwestern Philippines by a consortium led by a unit of Philippine National Oil Co flowed 5,100 barrels of oil per day (bpd), the Department of Energy said on Thursday.
"The well flowed at a rate of 5,100 bopd on June 4 which was diverted to the burner due to the presence of hydrogen sulfide gas," DOE director Griselda Bausa said in a drilling report.
DOE oil and gas Ismael Ocampo told Reuters the consortium was hoping to achieve a flow rate of 10,000 bpd.
The PNOC-Exploration Corp, operator of the Calauit 1B well, said that it will continue production logging tests.
The group started the test on May 15, when the well flowed 6,578 bopd, to assess the commercial viability of the field, Ocampo said.

Other members of the consortium are SOCDET Production Pty Ltd, Dragon (Far East) Ltd, Oriental Petroleum & Minerals Corp, Balabac Oil Exploration & Drilling Co, Basic Petroleum and Minerals, Unioil and Gas Development Co Inc, Palawan Oil and Gas Exploration Corp, TransAsia Oil and Energy Development Corp and Sinophil Corp.
